claim_scope: Generic wave-dominated delta geological process/form concept informed by actual NPS text and NASA Nile orbital photograph as modern large-scale coast analog. Original coastline and channel geometry, not Nile DEM, named site, precise age, ecosystem, exact dimensions or reconstruction before human modification. NASA photo clearly contains cultivated plain and modern distributary context; these are not modeled. Nominal2400x1800x60m educational tile; shallow water volume and palette artistic. Wave dominance inferred from smooth slight seaward bulge with few mouths, not proved by blue color or plumes.
